findings.primary_conclusion: Treaty Article 12 remains applicable because it is not included in the temporary suspension. Protocol Article VII reduces the Czech source-state ceiling under Article 12(2) to 5%. Application requires a Belarus resident who is the beneficial owner, a payment classified as royalties under Article 12, no overriding permanent-establishment connection and application of the special-relationship limitation.
